import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic

theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 1) : (x ^ 3 - 1) / (x - 1) = x ^ 2 + x + 1 := by
  have h1 : x ^ 3 - 1 = (x - 1) * (x ^ 2 + x + 1) :=
    by rw [Real.rpow_add, Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_sub_one' 0_lt_one (by simp), mul_sub]
  have h2 : (x ^ 3 - 1) / (x - 1) = (x - 1) * (x ^ 2 + x + 1) / (x - 1) :=
    by rw [h1]
  have h3 : (x - 1) * (x ^ 2 + x + 1) / (x - 1) = x ^ 2 + x + 1 :=
    by rw [mul_div_self (by simp) (by simp)]
  rw [h1, h2, h3]
